references.text: Earlier instructions about the Day of Atonement in Leviticus, where it is also commanded that the people shall humble themselves and keep a Sabbath rest.
Reference to the tenth day of the seventh month as the Day of Atonement, when the trumpet shall sound.
Parallel text giving detailed instructions about the offerings on the Day of Atonement.
Description of the annual atonement to be performed on the altar, linked to the Day of Atonement.
The New Testament explains how the high priest entered the Most Holy Place once a year with blood, pointing back to the Day of Atonement.
